reviewFindings: R18J2 failed because the entrypoint default named a nonexistent proposal root.
A fresh signed STATUS response proved PROCESSOR_CONFIG.json.stateRoot is C:\ProgramData\ArgosEdgeLabRO\AllWaferProcessorV2.
R18L carried the corrected proposal root only in a manifest contract field, but the portal does not translate that field into a command-line argument.
R18L's unchanged entrypoint therefore used its old default and failed at the same preflight assertion before worker start.
rootCause: The corrected live root was not embedded in the actual no-argument entrypoint default used by the endpoint.
authorizedCorrection: In a fresh R18M namespace, change only Invoke-R18JCorpusLaunch.ps1 parameter ProposalRoot default from D:\AFCV1\review\identity\proposals to C:\ProgramData\ArgosEdgeLabRO\AllWaferProcessorV2\identity\proposals, then rerun all exact local and publication gates.
